==================
Variable scope - global vs local
==================

x = 10

func main
    for t = 1 to 10
        mycounter()
    next

func mycounter
    see x + nl
    x--

==================
For in loop modifying list items
==================

aList = 1:5
for x in aList
    switch x
    on 1  x = "one"
    on 2  x = "two"
    on 3  x = "three"
    on 4  x = "four"
    on 5  x = "five"
    off
next
see aList

---

(source_file
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (binary_expression
        (number)
        (number))))

    variable: (identifier)
    (identifier)
    (switch_statement
      (identifier)
      (case_clause
        (number)
        (expression_statement
          (assignment_expression
            (identifier)
            (string))))
      (case_clause
        (number)
        (expression_statement
          (assignment_expression
            (identifier)
            (string))))
      (case_clause
        (number)
        (expression_statement
          (assignment_expression
            (identifier)
            (string))))
      (case_clause
        (number)
        (expression_statement
          (assignment_expression
            (identifier)
            (string))))
      (case_clause
        (number)
        (expression_statement
          (assignment_expression
            (identifier)
            (string))))))
  (see_statement
    (identifier)))

==================
Setter and getter (method-based property access)
==================

o1 = new person
o1.name = "Youssef"
see o1.name + nl

o1 { name = "Ahmed"  see name }

Class Person
        name family = "Elkholey"
        func setname value
            name = value + " " + family
        func getname
            return "Mr. " + name

---
